faxDelivered.closingText: We will send a reminder in the second week of January {v0}, giving over three months' notice before the deadline, and a further reminder if the filing remains outstanding. Because company and ownership details are retained on file, a returning filing takes about five minutes.
faxDelivered.closingText2: Form 5472 remains an annual requirement for as long as {v0} remains a foreign-owned U.S. entity. The next return covers tax year {v1} and is due on {v2}. Late or missed filings carry a statutory penalty of $25,000 per return, so the date is worth noting now.

Final return

Because this filing was submitted as a final return for a dissolved entity, no further Form 5472 filings are required provided the company does not resume activity. extensionApplicationConfirmation.steps: It shows the fax was transmitted to the IRS. It is not an IRS acceptance of the extension.
extensionApplicationConfirmation.steps2: We email you the fax confirmation.
extensionApplicationConfirmation.steps3: Orders are faxed within 2 business days; for a tax year that has not ended yet, we fax it in the first business days after 1 January.
extensionApplicationConfirmation.steps4: We fax it to the IRS Ogden PIN Unit.
extensionApplicationConfirmation.steps5: “Foreign-owned U.S. DE” is written across the top and Form 1120 code 12 is entered, as the IRS instructions describe for a foreign-owned disregarded entity.

extensionApplicationConfirmation.deadlineText: Reply with the tax year you need the extension for. Form 7004 must be filed by the original due date of the return (15 April for a calendar-year LLC). It extends the time to file, not to pay.
extensionApplicationConfirmation.deadlineText2: For tax year {v0}, Form 7004 must be filed by {v1}. A valid extension moves the due date of the Form 5472 and pro forma Form 1120 to {v2}. It extends the time to file, not to pay.
